hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in */cdk-projects/0[134]-*/lib/*.ts|*/cdk-projects/0[134]-*/bin/*.ts) DIR=$(echo "$FILE" | sed 's|/lib/.*|/|;s|/bin/.*|/|'); cd "$DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20;; */cdk-projects/0[256]-*/*.py) echo 'Python file edited - run pytest to validate';; esac
FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.env|*.env.*|*credentials*|*secret*) echo 'BLOCKED: Sensitive file edit blocked' && exit 1;; esac
